issues.quote: Many people think the animals were a safe test.
issues.problem: The sources never say why animals went first or that they were a safe test. "Many people think" is invented support, and "safe" is misleading because nobody knew yet whether a flight was safe. The sources only mention some concern about the effects of flight.
issues.fix: Nobody had flown in a balloon before, and people were not sure what flying high would do to a living thing. So the animals went first to find out.
